conditions.excluded: file discovery and sizing, baseline loading/writing, result comparison and JSON digest
conditions.memory: process high-water RSS also includes baseline/result vectors and their serialization
conditions.phases: summed worker phase wall durations, not CPU time or latency; may exceed pass wall time
conditions.pool: new bounded scoped threads each pass; one parser per worker, reused across files
conditions.schedule: dynamic atomic queue, descending source byte size with path tie-breaker
conditions.scope: raw syntax only; no semantic analysis or retained whole-project trees
conditions.validation: every file's path, content hash, byte count, and syntax counts match the sequential baseline; full AST shapes are not compared in this experiment
conditions.wall: includes pool startup, parser setup, reads, parse, inspection, hashing, tree disposal, joins, and result sorting
